description: Land Title Settlement Department - Illawatura, Udapalatha D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320037 (23/278)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (Nos. 101-105) with particulars including owner names, extent of land, nature of title, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification category.
